records.context: A cycle starts at a cytokinesis (birth) and ends at the next cytokinesis of the same cell (division). On the ``mother`` branch the cell is a mother and the cycle runs between two consecutive buds of hers; on the ``daughter`` branch the cell is a former bud, born at its own separation, and the cycle ends at the cytokinesis of its first bud. Birth size is the cell's size at the birth frame; division size is the cell's plus its bud's size at the division frame; added size is their difference. A cycle whose cytokinesis on either end was not fitted (:func:`budding_cytokinesis`), or whose next bud emerged before the previous one separated, is left out. ``volume`` is the sphere of the same projected area, summed over cell and bud.

records.context: The model this reads (stated, not tested by it): a budding cycle runs from bud emergence, the first frame the bud's track is seen, to cytokinesis. With ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), cytokinesis is the last frame the bud touches its mother before they are seen apart on ``min_separated`` consecutive frames on which both are labelled (``method='contact'``). When the masks never show that, the bud's area curve is read instead: the growth rate over ``growth_frames`` frames peaks while the bud grows on its mother, and cytokinesis is the first later frame at which it has fallen to ``plateau_fraction`` of that peak (``method='growth_plateau'``); only frames before the bud's own first bud are read, since a cell cannot bud before it has separated. This assumes the bud's growth slows when it separates, which is a weaker reading than contact: a daughter that keeps growing as fast after separation is not fitted. A bud with neither is not fitted and its ``status`` says why; no cytokinesis time is invented.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.budding_cytokinesis#1
records.source: The model this reads (stated, not tested by it): a budding cycle runs from bud emergence, the first frame the bud's track is seen, to cytokinesis. When the masks never show that, the bud's area curve is read instead: the growth rate over ``growth_frames`` frames peaks while the bud grows on its mother, and cytokinesis is the first later frame at which it has fallen to ``plateau_fraction`` of that peak (``method='growth_plateau'``); only frames before the bud's own first bud are read, since a cell cannot bud before it has separated. This assumes the bud's growth slows when it separates, which is a weaker reading than contact: a daughter that keeps growing as fast after separation is not fitted. A bud with neither is not fitted and its ``status`` says why; no cytokinesis time is invented.
records.translation: 本函数所依据的模型（作为前提陈述，本函数不检验它）：一个出芽周期从芽出现（即首次看到芽轨迹的那一帧）持续到胞质分裂。提供 ``contacts``（:func:`bud_contacts`）时，胞质分裂是芽与母细胞在连续 ``min_separated`` 帧（两者均被标记）中被看到分开之前，芽接触母细胞的最后一帧（``method='contact'``）。若掩膜始终未显示这一点，则改为读取芽的面积曲线：在 ``growth_frames`` 帧上计算的生长速率在芽附着于母细胞生长时达到峰值，胞质分裂是此后生长速率首次降至峰值的 ``plateau_fraction`` 的那一帧（``method='growth_plateau'``）；只读取芽自身第一个芽之前的帧，因为细胞在分离之前不能出芽。这假定芽在分离时生长减慢，比接触判断更弱：分离后仍以同样速度生长的子细胞不会被拟合。两者都不具备的芽不被拟合，其 ``status`` 说明原因；不会臆造任何胞质分裂时间。

records.context: A cell divides at the alignment frame of :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (the last frame before a daughter is seen), so the label of frame ``t`` is 1 when that frame lies in ``t .. t + frames - 1``. A frame is labelled 0 only when the cell is seen past ``t + frames`` without dividing or its next division comes later; a frame whose horizon runs past the end of its track without a division is left out, because a lost or departing cell may divide unseen. records.source: A cell divides at the alignment frame of :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (the last frame before a daughter is seen), so the label of frame ``t`` is 1 when that frame lies in ``t .. t + frames - 1``. A frame is labelled 0 only when the cell is seen past ``t + frames`` without dividing or its next division comes later; a frame whose horizon runs past the end of its track without a division is left out, because a lost or departing cell may divide unseen. For budding the mother's divisions are her buds, and her age restarts at each bud emergence; for fission age counts from the track's first frame. Features use the current and earlier frames only.
records.translation: 细胞在 :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` 的对齐帧（看到子细胞之前的最后一帧）分裂，因此帧 ``t`` 的标签在该帧位于 ``t .. t + frames - 1`` 之内时为 1。只有当细胞在 ``t + frames`` 之后仍被看到且未分裂，或其下一次分裂来得更晚时，该帧才标记为 0；若某帧的预测范围超出其轨迹末端且其间没有分裂，则该帧被排除，因为丢失或离开视野的细胞可能在未被看到时分裂。对于 budding，母细胞的分裂就是她的芽，她的年龄在每次芽出现时重新计算；对于 fission，年龄从轨迹的第一帧开始计算。特征仅使用当前帧和更早的帧。

records.context: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.label: spacr.division_prediction.predict_divisions#1
records.source: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.translation: 同一轨迹的各帧几乎彼此相同，因此默认从每条轨迹（按 ``movie`` 和 ``track_id``）以固定的 ``sample_seed`` 抽取一个被标记的帧，使每条轨迹在训练和评估中只计一次。各折按影片分组（scikit-learn ``GroupKFold``，折数为 ``min(folds, number of movies)``），因此每个预测都由从未见过该影片的模型给出。在模型之外，还在相同的留出行上为三个对照评分：``age_only``（仅使用细胞年龄的同一学习器）、``shuffled``（用在每部训练影片内置换的标签训练的同一学习器，其 AUROC 应接近 0.5）和 ``majority``（一个常数得分：AUROC 为 0.5，AUPRC 等于阳性比例）。AUROC 和 AUPRC 在全部留出预测上合并计算。影片数达到 ``min_movies`` 部及以上时，其 95% 区间对影片进行有放回重抽样；影片较少时对行重抽样，这会把同一细胞的各帧视为独立，区间过窄，``ci_note`` 会注明这一点。模型相对每个对照的优势在相同的抽样中重抽样（配对）。置换重要性（打乱某一特征时留出 AUROC 的下降量）在各折之间取平均。
